_about: How this election is imported. tools/import/run.mjs downloads each official list named here and rewrites official/<unit>/ only when the file changed. To add a Michigan county, add its clerk's Official Candidate List PDF (most counties publish the same report) with format "mi-county". 'colleges' says which part of a county votes in each community-college race; 'wardMaps' links each city's ward map for the ward picker.
name: November 3, 2026 General Election
